faqs.question: Where do blog posts come from?
faqs.answer: Published posts are stored in the platform database; run seed_marketing_cms or create posts in admin for a populated /blog/.

faqs.question: Can I customize the blog intro?
faqs.answer: Yes—MarketingContent key blog_list_intro overrides the intro HTML on the blog index.
